purpose: Make text feel embedded in the Mountain Noir world rather than superimposed captions.

rules.frequency: one persistent low-opacity channel mark plus sparse opening and chapter treatment
use_cases: persistent lower-right channel identity: MOUNTAIN NOIR
rules.palette: warm off-white / aged paper / muted gold, scene-motivated
rules.opacity: persistent mark at 58%; chapter treatments 62–88% only during their short emergence windows
